scenario: lookup
description: One A record query and response over UDP. The payloads encode www.example.test in RFC 1035 wire format.
vars:
  server_port: 53
flows:
  - id: query
    module: dns
    l4: udp
    client:
      - connect: { port: "{{ vars.server_port }}" }
      - send: "{{ hex('12340100000100000000000003777777076578616d706c6504746573740000010001') }}"
      - expect: { min_bytes: 12, timeout_ms: 2000 }
      - close: fin
    server:
      - accept: { port: "{{ vars.server_port }}" }
      - expect: { min_bytes: 12, timeout_ms: 2000 }
      - send: "{{ hex('12348180000100010000000003777777076578616d706c6504746573740000010001c00c000100010000012c0004c0000201') }}"
      - close: fin

scenario: web_get
description: One TCP connection that issues keepalive GET requests for objects of a fixed size.
vars:
  host: www.example.test
  path: /index.html
  server_port: 8080
  requests: 4
  body_size: 4096
  user_agent: "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) FixingPointSystem/0.1"
flows:
  - id: page
    module: http1
    client:
      - connect: { port: "{{ vars.server_port }}" }
      - loop:
          count: "{{ vars.requests }}"
          do:
            - send: "GET {{ vars.path }} HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: {{ vars.host }}\r\nUser-Agent: {{ vars.user_agent }}\r\nAccept: */*\r\n\r\n"
            - expect: { pattern: "\r\n\r\n", timeout_ms: 5000 }
            - expect: { bytes: "{{ vars.body_size }}", timeout_ms: 5000 }
      - close: fin
    server:
      - accept: { port: "{{ vars.server_port }}" }
      - loop:
          count: "{{ vars.requests }}"
          do:
            - expect: { pattern: "\r\n\r\n", timeout_ms: 5000 }
            - send: "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nServer: fps/0.1\r\nContent-Type: text/html\r\nContent-Length: {{ vars.body_size }}\r\n\r\n{{ fill(vars.body_size) }}"
      - close: fin
